name: Galapagos Horizon

seo.title: Galapagos Horizon Trimaran: Cruises | James Wild & Co
seo.description: Galapagos Horizon, Royal Galapagos' 16-guest trimaran: 8 balcony cabins, 4 to 8-day routes from Baltra and San Cristobal. 2026 and 2027 dates and rates.

tagline: The only trimaran in the Galapagos, with a private balcony on all eight cabins.
answer: Galapagos Horizon is a 38-metre trimaran built in 2018 and sailed by Royal Galapagos, which calls her the only trimaran in the Galapagos. She carries 16 guests in 8 double cabins, each with a private balcony, with 9 crew, a cruise director and one bilingual naturalist guide. Routes run 4, 5, 7 or 8 days from Baltra or San Cristobal. Royal Galapagos calls her excellent for groups and families.
facts: 125 ft (38 m), beam 43 ft (13 m), draft 6.2 ft (2 m)
8 doubles, each with a private balcony: 4 on the Upper Deck, 4 on the Main Deck
4, 5, 7 or 8 days; joins San Cristobal and Baltra
Minimum age not published; 20% off for under 15s
overview: Galapagos Horizon is a three-hulled yacht built in 2018. Royal Galapagos, an Ecuadorian company running small yachts in the islands since 2012, calls her the only trimaran sailing the Galapagos and says the triple hull gives smooth cruising.

She takes 16 guests in eight double cabins, four on the Upper Deck and four on the Main Deck, all with a private balcony, private bathroom, hot water and air conditioning. Shared spaces are a lounge, a bar, an al fresco dining area and a solarium with a jacuzzi. Internet is available on board.

Two 8-day routes link San Cristobal and Baltra: A covers San Cristobal, Espanola, Bartolome, Santiago, Rabida, Genovesa and North Seymour; B covers Santiago, the western coasts of Isabela and Fernandina, the Santa Cruz highlands, Floreana and Santa Fe. Shorter 4 and 5-day sections and a 7-day loop on selected dates are cut from the same weeks.
why: A balcony on every cabin is rare at 16 guests, and the trimaran hull is a talking point in its own right. Royal Galapagos calls her excellent for groups and families.
The two 8-day weeks fit end to end into 15 days, and the 4 and 5-day sections let a shorter trip still reach Genovesa or the western islands.

inclusions: Use of expedition gear: kayaks, paddle boards, wetsuits, snorkel gear, underwater cameras, walking sticks and binoculars
exclusions: Flights between mainland Ecuador and the Galapagos
children: Royal Galapagos does not publish a minimum age for this yacht. It gives children under 15 a 20% discount when one child shares a cabin with one full-paying adult (not with 2X1 promotions). Royal Galapagos describes Galapagos Horizon as excellent for groups and families.
faqs: She is a trimaran, a yacht with three hulls, and Royal Galapagos says she is the only one sailing the Galapagos. All eight cabins have a private balcony.
How many guests does Galapagos Horizon carry?
Sixteen, in eight double cabins, with nine crew, a cruise director and one bilingual naturalist guide.
Four, five or eight days, plus a seven-day loop on selected dates. The two eight-day weeks join San Cristobal and Baltra and can be sailed back to back.
How much does a Galapagos Horizon cruise cost?
Royal Galapagos' 2027 rack rates are US$9,945 per person for 8 days, US$6,345 for 5 days and US$4,245 for 4 days. Flights, the US$200 park fee and the US$20 transit card are extra.
Can I charter the whole trimaran?
Yes. A 2027 private charter for 16 is US$137,450 for 8 days or US$58,450 for 4 days, as published by Royal Galapagos.
Week A reaches Espanola, Bartolome, Santiago, Rabida, Genovesa and North Seymour. Week B reaches the western coasts of Isabela and Fernandina, the Santa Cruz highlands, Floreana and Santa Fe.
Is Galapagos Horizon good for families?
Royal Galapagos calls her excellent for groups and families, and gives children under 15 20% off when sharing with one full-paying adult. A minimum age is not published.

All meals, island transfers, excursions, expedition gear including kayaks, paddle boards, wetsuits and snorkel gear, a naturalist guide and carbon offsetting. Flights, alcohol, park fees and tips are extra.
